name: Eliphaz
summary: Eliphaz the Temanite was the first of Job's three friends to speak, and he told Job that no innocent man ever perished. In the end the LORD said Eliphaz and his two friends had not spoken of Him what was right.

key_moments.title: Comes to Comfort Job
key_moments.description: When Eliphaz, Bildad and Zophar heard of Job's trouble, they met to come and comfort him. They wept, tore their robes and sat with him on the ground seven days without a word.

key_moments.title: Tells Job the Innocent Never Perish
key_moments.description: Eliphaz asked Job to remember whether anyone innocent had ever been destroyed. He said he had seen that those who plant trouble and sow evil harvest the same.

key_moments.title: Rebuked by the LORD
key_moments.description: The LORD told Eliphaz that His wrath was kindled against him and his two friends for not speaking right of Him, as Job had. They were to bring offerings to Job, and Job would pray for them.
